upstream.revisionPolicy: Evaluate the exact functional-release commit. Do not infer new capability from the docs-only v0.8.8 tick or moving main.

materialChanges: Synthesizes verifiable coding-agent training/evaluation environments from repository history and tests.
Stable pr_runtime and commit_runtime pipelines use executable test-based rewards and emit Harbor-compatible content-addressed tasks.
Complements but does not duplicate Harbor: Repo2RLEnv is the task/environment synthesis plane; Harbor is the execution/benchmark plane.
riskBoundaries: First evaluation uses only fixed public non-secret repositories at exact source refs.
No private repositories, production credentials, Hugging Face writes, or training-corpus admission.
No external LLM/provider calls unless a successor authorization explicitly permits them.
Repository builds execute only in disposable isolated containers with bounded resources and no production network/secret authority.
Generated tasks must be tested for gold-patch/oracle leakage, provenance completeness, reward validity, and reproducibility.

acceptance: Pin source repository, base revision, mined PR/commit identity, pipeline and generated task content hash.
Generate from a small fixed public fixture corpus and compare reruns for stable task identities and reward behavior.
Reject tasks whose instruction, fixtures, metadata, or verifier leak the oracle/gold patch beyond the declared reward contract.
Fail closed on bootstrap/build/test failure and preserve UNAVAILABLE separately from FAIL.
Do not publish generated datasets or admit them to training until rights, contamination, quality and provenance gates separately pass.

deduplication.harborRelationship: complementary synthesis layer, not duplicate runtime layer

alignment.claimBoundary: Environment synthesis evidence does not authorize training, model qualification, dataset publication, provider routing, or production serving.
